Square area radius in chunks, centered on the player's chunk. Default 6, max 32. Only chunks already loaded by the server can be changed, and large radii cost a lot of server time.
blockshuffle.configuration.cooldownSecon: Minimum delay between two swaps. Prevents continuous damage (fire, drowning, poison, starvation) from triggering swaps every 10-20 ticks. 0 disables the cooldown.
blockshuffle.configuration.blocksPerTick: Write budget per server tick. Higher finishes the swap faster but causes longer individual tick spikes. The scan phase uses 50x this value.
blockshuffle.configuration.maxSwapBlocks: Safety valve. If the picked pair would affect more blocks than this, the pair is re-rolled (up to typePickRetries). If every roll exceeds it, the swap is skipped. 0 = unlimited (not recommended).
blockshuffle.configuration.typePickRetri: How many times a block pair may be re-rolled when the safety valve rejects it.
blockshuffle.configuration.fluidsPartici: Whether water and lava take part in the swap. Neighbor updates are suppressed, but lava may still flow afterwards and react with water.
blockshuffle.configuration.keepPlantsAtt: Swap without triggering neighbor/shape updates, so flowers, grass, kelp and sand stay in place (possibly floating) and far fewer item drops are created. Turning this off follows vanilla cascading updates: many drops and heavy lag.
blockshuffle.configuration.blockBlacklis: Blocks that never take part in a swap (neither as candidate nor as target). Air and block entities (chests, signs, furnaces...) are always excluded and do not need to be listed.
blockshuffle.configuration.dimensions.to: Dimensions where the swap is active, e.g. ["minecraft:overworld"]. Use "*" or an empty list for all dimensions.
Manual pick weight per block, format "minecraft:stone=3.0" (=1.0 when omitted). Unlisted blocks use 1.0; weight 0 means the block is never picked. Weight only affects which types get picked, not how many blocks are swapped.
blockshuffle.configuration.swapMessageMo: How the swapped block names are shown in game: chat, above the hotbar, big text in the screen center, or no message.
blockshuffle.configuration.swapMessageSc: Who sees the swap message. The triggering player always sees it, regardless of this setting.
blockshuffle.configuration.dropEntityLim: Maximum number of dropped item entities inside the area during the watch window. Existing drops count towards the limit; new drops beyond it are cancelled. 0 = unlimited.
blockshuffle.configuration.dropWatchSeco: How long the dropped item limit stays active after a swap. Leaf decay, falling sand and plant drops happen after the swap itself, so the limit only applies inside this window.
